League and Club Records from Mike Edwards

Promising a fine season to come, Mike Edwards cleared 5.30 in a pole vault competition in Oregon on February 17th but then in the opening British League fixture on May 11th he took the league record, club record and his personal best to new heights with 5.36m.

While Jon Ridgeon was running the B hurdles at the Parcelforce Games, and Mike Edwards was getting over 5.20, and Lenny Paul, Fred Salle and new signing Ikem Billy were in action, a member with a few more years services than those was also putting in an effort along the Crystal Palace home straight.
Someone suggested getting down to the pole vault area to have a chat to Mike Edwards, as he seems to know about these things! But Mike was busy having an outstanding competition.
MIKE EDWARDS (GBR) - Pole Vault Qualifying round. 27 Aug. 16:40; pool 1; qual. 5.60 or 12; temp. 22C; humidity 62%.

Abi Ekoku threw 52.54 for 4th in the discus, Ian Tullet and Mike Edwards both cleared 5.00 in the pole vault for 5th and 6th, Warren Caswell high jumped 2.05 for 5th and Lennie Paul was 4th in the 100 metres in 10.68.

Mike Edwards again came up trumps in the pole vault, setting a ground record, but the relay teams were a hotch potch. This match saw the birth of new sprint relay stars with triple jumper Derek Browne blasting from the gun to hand over to Abi Ekoku.

We won the event in a new Club Record of 3:13.25 and as the final points tally took into account Gary Staines 'B' 1500m win (if only he'd run the 'A') and Mike Edwards and Dylan McDermot's fine pole vault points we found we had lost by just one point.
Up and away was Mike Edwards who achieved first time clearances at 5.20, 5.30, 5.40 and 5.50m only to miss a new Commonwealth pole vault record of 5.66m by the narrowest of margins.
In the pole vault we got well clear of the 'Eastern Electric' men with Ian Tullett surprising a tired Mike Edwards to break Mike's sequence of seven straight league wins.

Best placed Belgravian was Mike Edwards with second place in the M45 Pole Vault.
